title: Why medical AI needs checks after it starts work
titleZh: 医疗AI投入使用后，为什么还要继续检查
summaryZh: 2026年10月6日的英国医疗AI公告强调持续监测与患者知情。文章区分“接受建议”和“已经实施”，并非个人医疗建议。
levelReason: 以解释性段落连接政策决定、原因、例子和后续步骤；有被动语态、定语从句和情态动词，医疗监管词得到解释。 编辑估计，非认证CEFR测评。

source.name: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency / GOV.UK
source.title: Government backs recommendations of NHS doctors-led AI Commission

adaptation: 英语机构原文的同语言分级改写及逐句中文翻译；排除图片、标识、所有外部直接引语和链接报告。事实日期与整理日期分开；口语问题及表达为教学补充。原语判断依据机构署名及英语编辑语境，不声称认证作者母语。

sentences.text: When an AI tool becomes part of healthcare, checking it once is not the end of the story.
sentences.zh: 当AI工具成为医疗服务的一部分时，检查一次并不意味着事情就结束了。

sentences.text: Its performance needs attention throughout the time it is used, especially when the technology changes.
sentences.zh: 在整个使用期间都需要关注它的表现，尤其是在技术发生变化时。

glosses.note: 介词，强调覆盖完整使用期间。
这里指工具在实际使用中的性能

sentences.text: That is a central idea in a UK government announcement published on 6 October 2026.
sentences.zh: 这是英国政府2026年10月6日发布的一份公告的核心观点。

sentences.text: The government accepted all 44 recommendations from an independent commission on the regulation of AI in healthcare.
sentences.zh: 政府接受了一个医疗AI监管独立委员会提出的全部44项建议。

sentences.text: Accepting the recommendations is a commitment to further work; it does not mean that every change has already happened.
sentences.zh: 接受建议意味着承诺继续开展工作，并不表示所有变化都已落实。

glosses.note: a commitment to +名词；此处不等于已经完成。

sentences.text: The MHRA, which regulates medicines and medical devices in the UK, is developing the next steps with other organisations.
sentences.zh: 负责英国药品及医疗器械监管的MHRA正与其他机构一起制定后续步骤。

sentences.text: The proposed approach pays more attention to how AI-enabled devices perform during their whole working life.
sentences.zh: 拟议的方法更加关注使用AI的器械在整个工作寿命中的表现。

sentences.text: Instead of relying too heavily on a single assessment, regulators want evidence from continuing use.
sentences.zh: 监管机构希望获得持续使用中的证据，而不是过度依赖一次评估。

glosses.note: 可数名词单数，与a single搭配。

sentences.text: The announcement also opened applications for the third phase of a programme called AI Airlock.
sentences.zh: 公告还宣布启动AI Airlock项目第三阶段的申请。

glosses.note: 复数；此处不是手机应用

sentences.text: This programme brings developers, regulators and healthcare partners together to explore difficult questions using real products.
sentences.zh: 这个项目让开发者、监管机构和医疗合作方聚在一起，利用真实产品探讨难题。

sentences.text: The new phase focuses on monitoring devices after they have entered use and managing them safely over time.
sentences.zh: 新阶段重点关注器械投入使用后的监测，以及长期安全管理。

sentences.text: The evidence collected will help shape future guidance, rather than act as a promise that every product is safe.
sentences.zh: 收集到的证据将帮助制定未来的指导意见，而不是承诺每一种产品都安全。

sentences.text: The MHRA plans to issue draft guidance by December 2026 on managing changes to AI-enabled medical devices.
sentences.zh: MHRA计划最迟于2026年12月发布关于管理AI医疗器械变化的指导意见草案。

glosses.note: draft guidance：尚非最终版本的指导意见。

sentences.text: A full roadmap covering responsibilities and timing is planned for publication by spring 2027.
sentences.zh: 涵盖责任分工与时间安排的完整路线图计划最迟于2027年春季公布。

sentences.text: The government also wants patients to be better informed about when AI is used in their care.
sentences.zh: 政府还希望患者能够更清楚地知道自己的医疗服务何时使用了AI。

sentences.text: Other commitments include involving patients in decisions and improving ways to seek redress when care falls below expected standards.
sentences.zh: 其他承诺包括让患者参与决策，以及在医疗服务未达到预期标准时改善寻求补救的途径。

glosses.note: seek redress是寻求补救，不一定指经济赔偿。

sentences.text: For readers, the important distinction is between an ambition to improve care and evidence that a particular tool actually does so.
sentences.zh: 对读者而言，重要的是区分改善医疗服务的愿望，与证明某一具体工具确实实现了改善的证据。

glosses.note: distinction between A and B：A与B的区别

words.note: 介词，强调覆盖完整使用期间。
a commitment to +名词；此处不等于已经完成。
可数名词单数，与a single搭配。
seek redress是寻求补救，不一定指经济赔偿。
draft guidance：尚非最终版本的指导意见。

sentences.note: 分号连接两个相关判断；does not mean that引出不能由前半句推出的结论。
the distinction is between A and B用于区分目标与证据，避免混为一谈。

questions.text: What would you want to know before an AI tool was used in your care?
questions.zh: 在医疗服务使用AI工具前，你想了解什么？

questions.text: Why might a one-time check be insufficient?
questions.zh: 一次性的检查为什么可能不够？

expressions.text: I would want clear information about how the tool is monitored.
expressions.zh: 我希望清楚了解这个工具如何被监测。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。

expressions.text: A useful aim still needs supporting evidence.
expressions.zh: 有价值的目标仍然需要证据支持。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。
